features.label: WebRTC web API (RTCPeerConnection)

patches.author: Resonance
patches.subject: Request a SystemClockDriver graph for remote audio tracks in RTCRtpReceiver.

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Move the send parameters into the RTCRtpSender::SetParameters task instead of copying them (Coverity CID 1704421)

features.summary: Remote WebRTC audio tracks now get the clock support they need to stay in sync. The sender also handles parameter updates without an unnecessary copy, a behind-the-scenes efficiency improvement.

features.label: Connection transport (ICE / DTLS)

patches.author: Ryan VanderMeulen
patches.subject: Always enforce the STUN rate limits and only assert on exceeding them in Nightly.

features.summary: Firefox now enforces STUN rate limits on WebRTC connections in all builds, helping prevent excessive connection traffic. Nightly builds additionally flag limit violations during testing.

features.label: Negotiation engine (JSEP)

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Avoid copying the media type info into JsepTrack and JsepTransceiver (Coverity CIDs 1703934, 1703916)

features.summary: The WebRTC negotiation engine now avoids copying media-type information while preparing tracks and transceivers. This is a behind-the-scenes efficiency improvement with no intended user-visible change.

features.label: Session negotiation (SDP)

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: vendor webrtc-sdp to 0.3.17;r=mjf,supply-chain-reviewers

features.summary: Firefox updated its bundled webrtc-sdp library, which parses SDP, the format WebRTC uses to describe a connection. This keeps the SDP component current; no specific user-visible behavior change is indicated by the patch title.

features.label: libwebrtc integration

patches.author: Philipp Hancke
patches.subject: Update the audio receive stream's sync group in place

features.summary: When a WebRTC audio stream’s synchronization group changes, Firefox now updates it in place instead of replacing it. This helps keep received audio aligned without disrupting the stream.

features.label: Connection transport (ICE / DTLS)

patches.author: Ryan VanderMeulen
patches.subject: Always enforce the STUN rate limits and only assert on exceeding them in Nightly.

patches.author: Michael Froman
patches.subject: Complete ICE gathering when it fails to start, so end-of-candidates is still signaled.

patches.author: Lars Eggert
patches.subject: Remove the unused WebSocketConnection classes and fold WebSocketChannel helpers.

patches.author: Michael Froman
patches.subject: remove USE_ICE and USE_TURN defines.

patches.author: Valentin Gosu
patches.subject: Stop calling nsIURIMutator.setSpec outside necko, and add a lint to prevent new callers.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Plug these leaks a little better.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: In TransportLayerDtls search for the single best cipher rather than the full advertised range.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Remove this ancient stund compatibility mode.

features.summary: Firefox tightened WebRTC connection handling: it enforces STUN rate limits and ensures ICE, the process for finding a network path, signals when candidate gathering fails. It also improves DTLS cipher selection and leak handling, while removing obsolete connection code and tightening use of a network URI API; these are reliability and maintenance changes rather than visible new features.

features.label: Session negotiation (SDP)

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: vendor webrtc-sdp to 0.3.17;r=mjf,supply-chain-reviewers

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: set port=0 in m-sections with unknown media types in answers;r=bwc

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: restore handling of unknown media types for webrtc-sdp;r=dbaker,bwc

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: align handling of OOB AV1 FMTP parameter handling between SDP parsers;r=dbaker

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: preserve existing Rsdparsa behavior wrt unknown media types;r=dbaker

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: hook up unknown media types in the rsdparsa C API;r=dbaker

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: update webrtc-sdp to 0.3.16;r=webrtc-reviewers,supply-chain-reviewers,mjf

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: allow unknown media types in rsdparsa wrapper;r=dbaker

features.summary: Firefox’s SDP handling now better preserves and negotiates media types it does not recognize, including reserving and reusing their sections in a WebRTC session description. The changes also align AV1 format-parameter handling between parsers and ensure unsupported media sections are marked inactive in answers, improving compatibility with other implementations.

features.label: WebRTC web API (RTCPeerConnection)

patches.author: Resonance
patches.subject: Request a SystemClockDriver graph for remote audio tracks in RTCRtpReceiver.

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Move the send parameters into the RTCRtpSender::SetParameters task instead of copying them (Coverity CID 1704421)

patches.author: Lars Eggert
patches.subject: Remove the media transport IPC and the socket process bridge.

patches.author: Lars Eggert
patches.subject: Always run WebRTC media transport in the content process.

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Remove redundant UniquePtr<...> ... = std::make_unique(...)

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Replace mozilla::MakeUnique by std::make_unique

patches.author: Tom Schuster
patches.subject: Part 2: Block WebRTC connections with Connection Allowlists.

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Ensure correct usage of std::forward in dom/media/

features.summary: WebRTC media transport now runs in Firefox’s content process, removing an older socket-process bridge, and connection allowlists can block WebRTC connections that are not permitted. Remote audio clock support and sender parameter handling were also improved; the remaining changes streamline internal C++ ownership and argument handling.

features.label: Negotiation engine (JSEP)

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Avoid copying the media type info into JsepTrack and JsepTransceiver (Coverity CIDs 1703934, 1703916)

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: compare unknown types deeply;r=bwc

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: recycle unknown media type m-sections;r=bwc

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: reserve mid for unknown media types;r=bwc

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Remove non-idempotent changes from bug 2079602

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Let remote H.264 max-fs/max-mbps override the profile-level-id limits.

features.summary: The WebRTC negotiation engine now handles unknown media types more consistently, including comparing them, reusing their session-description sections, and reserving their IDs. It also lets a remote H.264 setting for frame size or frame rate take precedence over limits implied by the codec profile, improving negotiation when peers advertise different capabilities.

features.label: libwebrtc build

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Remove the ./mach bootstrap step DONTBUILD

patches.author: Michael Froman
patches.subject: fix tar/gc issues in fetch_github_repo.py

patches.author: Michael Froman
patches.subject: allow ignoring missing branch-head commits per Firefox version.

patches.author: Michael Froman
patches.subject: use the public libwebrtc repo to show branch-head commits.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: updated default_config_env for v157

patches.author: Alex Hochheiden
patches.subject: Add backend target resolution and use it for `mach gtest`

features.summary: Firefox’s libwebrtc build and test tooling was updated to fetch source more reliably and better handle missing branch information across Firefox versions. The changes also improve how the public WebRTC repository’s revisions are displayed and how Google Test targets are selected.

features.label: WebRTC tests

patches.author: Lars Eggert
patches.subject: Update docs and comments that described the socket process.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Don't emit fmtp or rtcp-fb for payload types excluded by setCodecPreferences.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Don't start early media reception when the receive track has no early codecs.

patches.author: Dale Harvey
patches.subject: Use moz-src for dom/media

features.summary: WebRTC now leaves out format and feedback details for codecs a page excludes with `setCodecPreferences`, and it waits to start early audio or video reception until compatible codecs are available. The related documentation and test-source updates are maintenance changes.

features.label: libwebrtc integration

patches.author: Philipp Hancke
patches.subject: Update the audio receive stream's sync group in place

patches.author: Philipp Hancke
patches.subject: Implement RTCEncodingOptions.keyFrame in RTCRtpSender.setParameters

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Replace misuse of std::forward by std::move in dom/

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Bug 2081656 (MOZ) - Recreate the send stream instead of reconfiguring it when the MID changes.

features.summary: WebRTC senders now support the `keyFrame` encoding option in `RTCRtpSender.setParameters`, allowing a page to request a key frame—an independently decodable video frame. Firefox also updates audio synchronization in place and recreates a send stream when its media-section ID changes, helping keep sending behavior correct during renegotiation.

features.label: Transportbridge

patches.author: Seungmin Kim
patches.subject: Paint I420 frames libwebrtc decodes itself in the color space they declare.

features.summary: Video frames decoded by libwebrtc are now displayed using the color space those frames declare. This helps preserve the intended colors in WebRTC video.

features.label: WebRTC

patches.author: Philipp Hancke
patches.subject: implement webrtc stats targetBitrate and remove totalEncodedBytesTarget

features.summary: WebRTC statistics now report `targetBitrate`, the encoder’s intended video or audio data rate, in place of the older `totalEncodedBytesTarget` metric. This gives sites a more direct measure for monitoring and adapting call quality.
